findings.title: Literal-marker XID correlation can bind SyncRep to an audit/identity transaction while semantic state is committed separately
findings.independent_canary: PostgreSQL 17.9: waited audit XID 779, later semantic payload XID 780, marker helper returned only 779, predicate accepted true after fresh joined semantic readback.
findings.repair: Bind transaction identity at the actual semantic persistence operation and require all writes constituting that semantic append to occur in the observed SyncRep transaction; add a split-marker/surrogate-join rejection canary.

findings.title: The injected record-only proxy itself exposes the concrete adapter capability
findings.authority: IRB BC-001/BC-013/BC-015; IA17-PROD-001/IA17-PROD-011; IWO persistence ownership boundary
findings.independent_canary: Owner built with submitted proxy recovered exact adapter through _port._inner and executed a private semantic method while precheck/postcheck were false and rewire_count was zero.
findings.repair: Inject a genuinely record-only persistence capability whose reachable state contains no concrete adapter, and add a direct injected-port recovery canary.
